name: ZX_ID_TCC_MAPPING_ALL
description: This table stores the list of tax classification codes applicable for an internal organization. This table also stores the mapping of migrated tax classification codes to the tax code identifiers of Payables and Receivables in prior releases.

columns.name: TCC_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: TAX_CLASS
columns.description: Column to indicate whether this tax code is applicable for Procure To Pay business flows or Order To Cash business flows. Possible values are INPUT and OUTPUT. NULL indicates it is applicable to both.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the tax code in AR_VAT_TAX_ALL or AP_TAX_CODES_ALL of prior releases for migrated records; tax rate identifier for all other records

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classification code. For migrated records, this column stores the tax code in AR_VAT_TAX_ALL or AP_TAX_CODES_ALL of prior releases.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: TAX_TYPE
columns.description: Tax type code from AR_VAT_TAX_ALL or AP_TAX_CODES_ALL of prior releases for migrated records; NULL for all other records

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Column to indicate the source from which the tax code is migrated for this internal organization. Possible values are AP and AR. Null indicates that the record is not migrated.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger defining column

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this tax code is active for the internal organization

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record
